title: General Hux
description: General Armitage Hux was raised by Brendol Hux, a radical commandant obsessed with the way soldiers of the Empire and later the First Order were trained. Accordingly, General Hux became a young and ruthless leader of the First Order, placed in charge of Starkiller Base. He gave the order to destroy the capital of the Republic, seeking advantages in his petty rivalry with Kylo Ren.
